scene_instructions: Apply roundness 0.55 only to the 10 actual menu button face CircleGraphic components and the one wrist flashlight face; leave hover CircleGraphic roundness 0.
Use requested per-purpose pastel face colors in both Swipe Round Menu and Left Forearm Buttons. Set internal icon/text to #29424D for contrast.
For both CALL faces set phoneIcon: 1 and symbolColor #29424D. Empty only inner CALL text; retain external CALL caption and all callbacks.

Add SoftButtonFeedback to these 11 existing button GameObjects. Set button and face refs. Optional symbol points at existing inner text/icon RectTransform, never the button root, caption, collider, or hover.
Use pressDuration 0.07 and releaseDuration 0.14. Symbol may be zero for a multi-piece icon or phone icon (the phone is drawn and moved by CircleGraphic).
Do not change existing RectTransforms, BoxCollider sizes, HandUIButton data, event callbacks, or input scripts.
Do not apply rounded styling to normal rectangular dashboard keys or invisible ray blockers.
